measure: share of Anthropic's AI research and development work that Claude 'leads' (R&D Automation Index, prototype)
notes: Quote: 'Claude "leads" 26% of Anthropic's AI R&D work.' Measurement month August 2026. Definition from the page: AI R&D work is the work of building frontier AI models at Anthropic; 'leads' is automation level 4 on the Epoch AI scale (AL0 no AI involvement to AL5 fully autonomous): 'it can complete most of the task end-to-end from a high-level prompt, while the human supervises'. Method: each week during July 2026 a random 20% of staff in model research and development departments was sampled; Claude research agents reviewed their work in Slack and internal documents to list tasks (about 15,000, in 542 categories), and separate Claude judges assigned automation levels.
